name: Send this to your person
title: “Even on my worst day?”
note: 3 slides, no redraws; photo 1 has the blanket around her only, not both
caption:
For the one you would wait for. Send it to them.

Love that stays on the hard days is a quiet gift. This verse is a picture of that kind of love, the kind that keeps hoping and keeps showing up.

1 Corinthians 13:7 (BSB)

Keep this one close.
